summary: AI agent: tools, turns, quota, chat panel, attachments, and propose/apply
description:
Gives a jPulse site an AI agent by configuration rather than by building one. A site registers scope and tools through hooks; the plugin runs turns, enforces authorization and quota, and streams replies over HTTP or a per-thread WebSocket.

  • Tools layer: named capabilities, four authorization gates, declarative per-turn budgets, shared utils/ai-tools/ modules
  • Agent layer: turn loop, provider contract, prompt assembly, reserve-then-settle quota
  • Attachments: tab-local sources, URL ingest, document-conversion call path, and Redis image staging
  • Panel: jPulse.ai.panel.create({ scopeType, scopeId }) — HTTP until a client-host tool is offered

Installs together with ai-mock and the hello-ai sample as @jpulse-net/plugin-ai-core. Disable Hello AI to hide the demo without turning off AI. A commercial provider is a separate package.
author: jPulse Team <team@jpulse.net>

schema.content:
This page is for plugin-local diagnostics that should not sit on the AI tab (they are easy to leave on).

  • Hello AI — bundled sample plugin, scratch-pad demo (no API key). Disable that plugin to hide the demo
  • Site Configuration → AI — master switch, roles, models, quota, loop limits
  • AI Core — live capability, models, and quota
  • AI usage — requests, tokens, and cost by subject and period
  • AI Core guide — installed-plugin documentation
  • Hello AI guide — the sample walkthrough
  • Plugin management — enable and disable AI plugins
